prompt: Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: rear-end collision in League City, Texas. Injury: neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1471; do not mention it.)
text: I was stopped at a red light on Highway 3 in League City, Texas, waiting to turn left, when I felt a hard jolt from behind. The impact pushed my vehicle forward into the intersection and my head snapped back against the headrest. The other driver stepped out of his car shortly afterward and said he had been looking at his phone. Both vehicles had to be moved to the shoulder before police arrived and took the report at the scene. I did not lose consciousness, but within an hour I had stiffness and sharp pain in my neck, along with a dull ache across my lower back that made it hard to sit upright. I went to an urgent care clinic that same day, where I was examined and told I had a neck and back strain. I have since stopped driving and am following the treatment plan my doctor provided.
